answer: Each identity's key is prism-split into shares held by independent notaries on three trust terraces. Every epoch the identity must complete a reassembly ceremony with at least one share from each terrace, proving its registered pigment fingerprint is under one live operator's control. Notaries rate-limit ceremonies and charge a fee, so every puppet costs a ceremony: N puppets need N quorums, and two identities with the same pigment collapse into one vote. Bribing one terrace never releases a usable key. An honest user pays one ceremony; a Sybil farmer pays per puppet, linearly, forever.
